description: Nishat Power Limited is an independent power producer incorporated in February 2007 under the Power Policy 2002 and a subsidiary of Nishat Mills Limited. It builds, owns, operates and maintains a fuel-fired combined-cycle power station with a gross capacity of 200 MW at Jamber Kalan, Tehsil Pattoki, District Kasur, Punjab. Output is sold to the National Transmission and Dispatch Company Limited under a 25-year agreement.
headOffice: Nishat House, 53-A Lawrence Road, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: nishatpower.com — About Us, Project Brief, Governance and Contact Us pages (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Electricity — 200 MW combined-cycle generation
products.summary: Eleven Wärtsilä 18V46 engines of 16.911 MW each plus a 13.979 MW steam turbine, RFO-fired, with net output of 195.305 MW; supplied to NTDC under a 25-year agreement.
